title: Platform Partitioning & Governance
message: GabAI v0.3.0 separates administrative governance to the Web Portal while optimizing the mobile app exclusively for Teachers and Students.
changelog:
• Web Administrative Portal: Multi-tier governance for Super Admin (SDO) and School Admin
• SDO School Manager: Issue official invite codes for all 29 Valenzuela secondary campuses
• School Admin Claim Flow: Onboard via official SDO invite code bound to DepEd School ID
• Administrative Remarks & Guidance: Review modules and submit pedagogical notes
• Mobile App Platform Security: Strict Teacher & Student access with Web Portal redirect for admins
